summary: Comprehensive testing of new Draw (10 XP, max 3/day) and Choose (5 XP, no daily cap) mechanics. All backend API tests pass (22/22). Frontend UI tests successful for draw/choose flows, filterable issues table, bookmark/PR/verify workflows, and navigation.

issues: Minor accessibility warning: Missing aria-describedby on login and PR dialogs (console warning only, not blocking). Already noted in iteration_3.

passed_tests: Backend: /api/issues returns list for table consumption with filtering
Backend: /api/draws/draw awards 10 XP and enforces max 3/day limit
Backend: /api/draws/choose awards 5 XP with NO daily cap (tested 5+ chooses)
Backend: Draw/Choose language and difficulty filters work correctly
Backend: History, Dashboard, Leaderboard, Stats, Activity endpoints working
Frontend: Reward Split signal displays 'Draw +10 XP | Choose +5 XP'
Frontend: Draw Budget shows remaining draws correctly (3→2→1→0)
Frontend: Issues table renders with search, language/difficulty filtering
Frontend: Choose button in table works and reveals selected issue card
Frontend: Draw flow shows 2x reward messaging in toast
Frontend: Bookmark creates active bookmark section with timer
Frontend: Submit PR dialog opens and accepts PR URL
Frontend: Verify Merge button appears and works (+100 XP)
Frontend: All navigation (Discover, Dashboard, Leaderboard, History) working
Frontend: User menu dropdown (Profile, Dashboard, Sign Out) working
